defs.def: the thick pale yellowish-white fatty liquid that rises to the top of milk, used in cooking or as a type of sauce to put on fruit, etc. 奶油；乳脂

ex.s: Enjoy fun history as we take you through San Francisco for a free taste of ice cream.
ex.t: 在旧金山免费品尝冰淇淋的同时，享受有趣的历史之旅吧。

ex.s: Top the whipped cream with your choice of chopped fresh fruit.
ex.t: 在打发的奶油上放上你选择的切碎的新鲜水果。

ex.s: INGREDIENTS 4 egg whites a little salt 1 cup sugar 2 teaspoons flour 2/3 teaspoon vinegar 2/3 teaspoon vanilla 2 cups cream fresh fruit 2 Read the text again and answer the questions.
ex.t: 配料：4个蛋清、少许盐、1杯糖、2茶匙面粉、2/3茶匙醋、2/3茶匙香草精、2杯奶油、新鲜水果。再读一遍文本，回答问题。

ex.s: The one strong point was the strawberries, for Jo had covered them in sugar and had a jug of cream to go with them.
ex.t: 唯一的亮点是草莓，因为乔在上面撒了糖，还配了一壶奶油。

ex.s: Cover the meringue with the whipped cream.
ex.t: 把打发好的奶油盖在蛋白霜上。

ex.s: When combined with berries or slices of other fruits, frozen bananas make an excellent base for thick, cooling fruit shakes and low fat “ice cream”.
ex.t: 当与浆果或其他水果切片结合时,冰冻的香蕉为厚、冷却的水果摇摆和低脂“冰淇淋”提供了极佳的基础。

defs.def: a sweet/candy that has a soft substance like cream inside 构成复合词

ex.s: 12．（1分）I didn't mean                  anything but the ice cream looked so good that I couldn't help               it．（  ）
ex.t: 12．（1分）我本没打算吃任何东西，但冰淇淋看起来太好吃了，我忍不住____（吃了）它。（  ）

defs.def: a soft substance or thick liquid used on your skin to protect it or make it feel soft; a similar substance used for cleaning things 护肤霜；洁净剂；清洗液
a pale yellowish-white colour 奶油色；淡黄色；米色
the best people or things in a particular group 精英；精华；精髓
to mix things together into a soft smooth mixture 把 … 搅成糊状（或奶油状）混合物

ex.s: Tiramisu does not look very attractive-it's brown, because of the coffee and dark chocolate, and white, because of the cream and cheese-but all these ingredients make it taste delicious!
ex.t: 提拉米苏看起来并不很吸引人——因为咖啡和黑巧克力是棕色的，因为奶油和奶酪是白色的——但所有这些原料混合在一起，使它美味无比！

ex.s: This makes a fun activity for a children’s party; they love feeding the fruit and frozen bananas into the top of the machine and watching the ice cream come out below.
ex.t: 这对儿童派对来说是个有趣的活动；他们喜欢把水果和冷冻香蕉从机器顶端投入，看着冰淇淋从下方出来。

defs.def: to completely defeat sb 彻底打败；狠揍
